{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm the sentinel value -1 in customer_age
print('Count of -1 in customer_age:', df['customer_age'].eq(-1).sum())

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing age)
valid_age_df = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age of valid customers
mean_age = valid_age_df['customer_age'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f'Mean age of customers (excluding -1 sentinels): {mean_age:.2f}')"}
